content.description: Spokes are responsible for pulling updates from the Hub broadcast directory on wakeup. This decentralizes the teaching process and ensures multi-agent environments stay synced without requiring a central push command for every change.
requirements: Wakeup protocol MUST pull global lugs from {hub_path}/broadcast/lugs/
Adoption of broadcast teachings follows the standard verification ceremony.

_behavior_directive.what_this_is: A foundational policy requiring all spokes to implement pull-based distribution.
_behavior_directive.what_this_is_NOT: The implementation logic itself, which lives in the 'wai' skill.
